steps.code:
# Extract liked song IDs
liked_ids = [song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs_page]
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_ids)

# Remove each liked song from the queue one by one, re-fetching queue each time
for sid in liked_ids:
    queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    # Find position of this song
    pos = None
    for item in queue:
        if item['song_id'] == sid:
            pos = item['position']
            break
    if pos is not None:
        print(f"Removing song {sid} at position {pos}")
        result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(position=pos, access_token=login_result['access_token'])
        print(result)
    else:
        print(f"Song {sid} not found in queue, skipping")
